test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are not required for admission; they are considered if submitted and used for placement. The international application says to check the requirements of your school, since some programs may ask for a score.

requirements.notes: International admission standard: minimum 2.5 GPA on a 4.0 scale for all previous coursework, plus proof of high school graduation for your country. $90 fee payable by credit card; it cannot be waived and the Common App fee waiver is not accepted. English scores must be submitted with the application, but no minimum English score is required for admission; applicants who do not meet full English proficiency can be admitted and take Applied English Center (AEC) courses. Academic records can be unofficial at application; official copies are needed before enrolling. Applicants with a gap of more than three months after high school need a short gap statement.

deadlines.label: Fall application deadline for students outside the U.S.
deadlines.notes: The page prints no year; taken as fall 2027. Spring deadline is Nov. 15. Students inside the U.S. have a July 25 fall deadline.

deadlines.label: Fall scholarship application deadline (complete application by this date)
deadlines.notes: The KU CDS (C14) separately lists Dec. 1 as the priority date for institutional scholarships.

english_policy.waiver_notes: A score or other proof must be submitted with the application, but a minimum is not required for admission. Applicants below the minimums take the online AEC Proficiency Test; those who pass can enroll full time in their degree, others enroll in the Applied English Center (concurrently or beforehand). Exempt: native English speakers; four years of college-prep English and a 2.5+ GPA from a qualifying English-speaking region or U.S.-accredited school; B or better in College English Composition 1 and 2 with 24+ credit hours; full IB diploma with English HL 5+; U.S. associate degree with a 2.5+ GPA. Also accepted: SAT EBRW 590, ACT English+Reading 48, AP English 4, A-level English grade B on both exams, TOEFL paper 60. Scores must be under two years old.

english.notes: Minimum for full-time degree coursework (not an admission minimum); iBT or Special Home Edition, scale before 2026-01-21.
IELTS Academic; minimum for full-time degree coursework.
For students with limited access to testing: scores can be shared through Duolingo for the application, but these students must still take the AEC test. No minimum is printed.

aid.notes: Renewable freshman scholarships based on high school GPA alone, available to international students (up to $64,000 over a KU career): KU Excellence 3.95-4.00 GPA $16,000/yr; Distinction 3.85-3.94 $14,000/yr; Achievement 3.70-3.84 $12,000/yr; Performance 3.50-3.69 $10,000/yr; Access 3.25-3.49 $8,000/yr. Renewal needs a 3.0 KU GPA and full-time enrollment; first bachelor's degree or eight semesters. Apply for admission by May 1 to be considered.

toefl.note: The undergraduate international pages say scores must be sent to KU by the testing agency but do not print a TOEFL code.

duolingo.note: Share scores with KU through the Duolingo system; no code.
